# function to extract mentioned items from a commitment body
# naive: find segment after 'bring' or 'can bring' or 'i will bring'

def extract_items(text):
    t=text.lower()
    # remove punctuation
    # extract after 'bring' keyword
    if 'bring' in t:
        t=t.split('bring',1)[1]
    # remove leading words
    t=t.strip(' .\n\t')
    # cut off at end sentences
    t=t.splitlines()[0]
    # remove leading 'i will' etc could remain
    # if has ' and ' keep separators
    # split by comma
    parts=[p.strip() for p in re.split(r',|\band\b', t) if p.strip()]
    # remove trailing punctuation
    parts=[re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s-]','',p).strip() for p in parts]
    return parts
